articles.title: U.S. Commerce Secretary warns Apple against buying Chinese memory
articles.description: Apple's memory woes are continuing, as Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick has urged Apple not to buy Mac memory chips from Chinese suppliers, despite the continuing supply crisis. CMXT is rapidly becoming a major player in memory - image credit: CXMT Apple has been testing memory chips from the controversial CXMT as a way to ease the current global chip shortage . However, the politically sensitive move has now led to a warning from the Trump administration, delivered by Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick. The Wall Street Journal reported on Friday about the warning to avoid purchasing Chinese chips. Following a tour of the new Apple Advanced Manufacturing Center in Houston, Lutnick told the media, "The Trump administration is not in favor of that." articles.title: PM Modi From Red Fort: India’s Self-Reliance Push, Semiconductor Boom And Manufacturing Surge

He highlights India’s semiconductor push, saying three plants have begun production for exports, with more facilities expected. PM Modi also points to major growth in defence, electronics, mobile phones, railways, Khadi and village industries, patents and digital transactions.
